extracted.EVIDENTIARY_STATUS: LOCATED ONLY, NOT CONFIRMED. All values stay null.
extracted.OMITTED_PATHWAY_trumprx: The prior gate contains NO trumprx pathway datum, NO trumprx source entry, and no record of any attempt against trumprx.gov, even though trumprx.gov is on this project's PRIMARY source allowlist. Search located a live product page at https://trumprx.gov/p/zepbound titled 'Zepbound Vial on TrumpRx'. An entire purchase pathway a patient could actually use is missing from the gate.
extracted.located_trumprx_pricing_claim: 'going through TrumpRx gets you the identical Zepbound at the identical price as going straight to LillyDirect. It starts at $299/month for the 2.5 mg dose, with $399 for 5 mg and $449 for 7.5-15 mg when the Self Pay Journey Program terms apply.' A competing located claim from the announcement period says TrumpRx purchasers would pay '$350 per month starting next year, with plans to lower costs to $250 per month over the next two years.' These do not agree, so the trumprx datum would be 'conflicting', value null.
extracted.KWIKPEN_CONFLICT_NOT_RECORDED: The prior gate marked the KwikPen self-pay datum 'unverified' as though only unconfirmed. Located evidence is actually in conflict. The prior report cites $299 at lowest dose up to $449 with a $449 LillyDirect refill cap. A located summary in this session instead says: 'For the single-dose pen format (KwikPen), the self-pay price through the savings program is $499 per month. However, LillyDirect self-pay covers vials only - KwikPen prices remain higher.' Confidence should be 'conflicting', not 'unverified'.
extracted.STALENESS_UNTESTED_BY_PRIOR_GATE: The prior gate anchored every vial figure to the December 1, 2025 announcement (prior prices $349/$499/$499) and never tested for supersession. Search located a BioSpace item headlined 'Lilly Cuts Zepbound Prices, Again, When Buying Through DTC Program', which the search channel attributes to approximately February 2026 and describes as 'another round of price cuts following competitive pressure'. Whether the Dec 2025 tiers still govern on 2026-07-30 is therefore an open staleness question, not a settled one. April 2026 aggregator pages still recite $299-$449, which is weak evidence of stability but not confirmation.
extracted.newer_primary_document_located: A Lilly media statement 'Zepbound (tirzepatide) KwikPen now available at self-pay pricing at major pharmacies nationwide in addition to LillyDirect' exists on lilly.gcs-web.com. It postdates and may supersede the KwikPen release the prior gate cited (investor.lilly.com/.../zepbound-tirzepatide-most-prescribed-weight-management). Neither was readable.
extracted.unit_clarification: One located summary defines the billing unit as 'a 28-day supply of four single-dose vials or one KwikPen', which bears on the prior gate's claim that the list-price unit was wholly unresolved.

verbatim_excerpt: Quoted from WebSearch summaries: 'Patients using the new TrumpRx.gov will be able to purchase the drugs without insurance for $350 per month starting next year, with plans to lower costs to $250 per month over the next two years.' And: 'going through TrumpRx gets you the identical Zepbound at the identical price as going straight to LillyDirect.' And: 'For the single-dose pen format (KwikPen), the self-pay price through the savings program is $499 per month. However, LillyDirect self-pay covers vials only - KwikPen prices remain higher.'
